title: DNF representation from a decision tree
statement: Let $f$ be a function from the sign cube $\{−1,1\}^n$ to $\{−1,1\}$, let $s,k$ be natural numbers, and let $T$ be a decision tree on $n$ binary coordinates with sign-valued leaves. Suppose that evaluating $T$ on the binary encoding of any input gives the value of $f$, that $T$ has at most $s$ leaves, and that its depth is at most $k$. Then $f$ has a DNF representation with at most $s$ terms and width at most $k$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a sign-valued Boolean function on $\{−1,1\}^n$
$T$ is a decision tree on $n$ binary coordinates with sign-valued leaves
